claims.disproof_condition: If transceiver/CPO architectures integrate TIA and driver functions into DSP or the SiPho PIC itself, reducing discrete SiGe TIA/driver content per port, the 1:1 coupling breaks and this claim should be downgraded.
claims.statement: Per Tower CEO, TIA/driver unit demand scales at roughly the same ratio as SiPho port growth, coupling Tower's SiGe TIA/driver business to the same AI optical connectivity demand as SiPho.

claims.disproof_condition: If Fab 7 or new SiPho/SiGe capacity utilization falls materially below the utilization model, or the $920M investment plan is cut or deferred, downgrade.
claims.statement: Tower is executing a $920M SiGe+SiPho capacity investment across Israel, Newport Beach, Texas, and the 12-inch Uozu fab, while Fab 7 runs fully utilized above the 85% utilization model — capacity tightness preceding the July 2026 METI-backed expansion.
